title: Add GET /invoices/:id/summary
prompt: Add an endpoint GET /invoices/:id/summary that returns `{ id, customer, currency, lineCount, totalCents, total }` where `total` is the formatted amount (for example "107.00 EUR"). Unknown ids return the same 404 shape as GET /invoices/:id. Add unit tests for the happy path and the 404. Follow the existing handler style; do not add a framework.
